DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お引き出しの金額は、お決まりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided how much you would like to withdraw?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅行用ですが、メモを見直しています。切符代も足しましたが、その分はもう払っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅行用現金計算に既払切符代を入れたと気づきを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's for a trip, but I'm checking my notes again. I added the train tickets too, but I had already paid for those.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you realized you included already-paid ticket costs in your calculation of cash for the trip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は、現金で必要な分をお考えなのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So today you are working out how much you will need in cash.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。食事と小さい買い物で、一日五千円を二日分にします。切符代は含めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一日五千円二日分で交通費を除くと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. For meals and small purchases, I'll allow five thousand yen a day for two days. I won't include the tickets.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are allowing five thousand yen per day for two days, excluding transportation costs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 合計一万円のご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you like ten thousand yen in total?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一万円です。家にある現金とは別に、この口座から一万円を引き出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 合計一万円を指定口座から引出希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ten thousand yen. Separately from the cash I have at home, I'd like to withdraw ten thousand yen from this account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a total withdrawal of ten thousand yen from the specified account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 金額をこちらの用紙に記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please enter the amount on this form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一万円と書きました。旅行の予算全部ではなく、今日この口座から出す金額です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 用紙一万円は旅費全体でなく引出額と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've written ten thousand yen. That's the amount I'm withdrawing from this account today, rather than my entire trip budget.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the ten thousand yen on the form is the withdrawal amount, rather than the total travel expenses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 金額と、手続きに必要な物を確認します。通帳はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check the amount and what is needed for the procedure. Do you have your passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持っています。記入した用紙と通帳を出します。メモは自分のかばんへ戻し、旅行中にも見られるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用紙通帳提出と自己予算メモ保管を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll hand you the completed form and my passbook. I'll put my notes back in my own bag so I can refer to them during the trip too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will submit the form and passbook and keep your own budget notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お手続きを確認します。楽しいご旅行になりますように。ご来店ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll check the withdrawal procedure. Have a lovely trip. Thank you for coming in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: レシートに、ご不明な点がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was there something unclear on your receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: リンゴは三個買いましたが、レシートには四個とあります。払った後に気づいたので、確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入リンゴ三個が会計済レシート四個と申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought three apples, but the receipt says four. I noticed after paying, so could you check it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you bought three apples, but the receipt you have already paid shows four. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品を拝見できますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この袋から三個を出します。ほかの商品はかごに残して、リンゴだけこの台へ置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋のリンゴ三個を台へ出して確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll take the three out of this bag. I'll leave the other items in the basket and put just the apples on this counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Take the three apples out of the bag onto the counter and ask for a check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確かに三個ですね。登録を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are indeed three. I'll check what was entered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。一個の値段は表示どおりなので、個数の所だけを見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 単価正しく個数だけの確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. The price per apple matches the display, so please check only the quantity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the unit price is correct and you only want the quantity checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一個百五十円のリンゴを一個分多く登録していました。三個で四百五十円に訂正し、百五十円をお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We entered one extra apple at one hundred and fifty yen each. We'll correct it to four hundred and fifty yen for three and refund one hundred and fifty yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 四個で六百円だった所が、三個で四百五十円になりましたね。新しいレシートと百五十円を受け取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三個四百五十円の訂正レシートと百五十円返金を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: So the six hundred yen for four has become four hundred and fifty yen for three. I've received the new receipt and the one hundred and fifty yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the corrected receipt for three apples at four hundred and fifty yen and the refund of one hundred and fifty yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 古いレシートは、こちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll keep the old receipt here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。新しい方を手元に残します。リンゴ三個を袋へ戻し、かごのほかの商品も全部持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新レシート保管と全商品を持帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: All right. I'll keep the new one. I'll put the three apples back in the bag and take home all the other items in the basket as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the new receipt and take all the purchases home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待たせしました。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for waiting. Take care on your way home. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お写真をお撮りしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like me to take your picture?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。家族四人を入れたいです。今、携帯が動画になっているので、写真へ戻してからお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族四人撮影を希望し携帯動画から写真へ戻すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, please. I'd like all four family members in it. My phone is on video now, so I'll switch it back to photo before handing it to you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a photo of four family members and say you will switch the phone from video to photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご準備できましたらお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll take the phone when you're ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真の画面になりました。家族はこのベンチの前に並びます。後ろの木も一緒に入るといいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真画面を用意しベンチ前の家族と背後の木を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's on the photo screen now. Our family will stand in front of this bench. It would be nice to include the tree behind us too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the photo screen is ready and request the family in front of the bench with the tree behind them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この位置からなら、皆さんと木が入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: From here I can fit everyone and the tree in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。私はかばんを持ったまま写ります。ベンチに置いて忘れないよう、そのままで大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: かばんを持ったまま写ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'll keep hold of my bag in the picture. That's fine, so I don't leave it on the bench and forget it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will be photographed holding your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、皆さんこちらをご覧ください。一枚お撮りします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Now, everyone, please look this way. I'll take one picture.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 撮ってくださってありがとうございます。四人とも入ったか、その写真を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 撮影に感謝し全員写ったか画像確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you for taking it. I'd like to look at the picture to see whether all four of us are in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Thank the person for taking the photo and ask to check that everyone is in the picture. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 携帯をお返しします。今の一枚をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here's your phone back. Please check the picture I just took.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 四人とも写っています。動画ではなく写真で残せました。家族にもこの一枚を見せてから、散歩へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四人の静止写真を確認し家族へ見せ散歩へ戻ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: All four of us are in it. We've saved a photo rather than a video. I'll show this picture to my family too, then we'll get back to our walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the still photo of all four, and say you will show your family and return to your walk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: いい思い出になりますね。それでは、ご家族で公園をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: It will be a lovely memory. Enjoy the park with your family. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご出発前に、携帯の充電をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to charge your phone before departure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。電池が少なくなりました。自分の充電器はあります。十分ほど使える場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人充電器で十分使える充電場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My battery is low. I have my own charger. Could you show me somewhere I can use it for about ten minutes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a charging spot where you can use your own charger for ten minutes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの充電台をお使いいただけます。お乗りになる列車まで、お時間はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use this charging station. Do you have time before your train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あと二十分あります。長く使わず、十分たったら片付けて乗り場へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発車二十分後で十分使用後移動すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have twenty minutes left. I won't use it for long; after ten minutes I'll pack up and head to the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that departure is in twenty minutes and you will move on after ten minutes of use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 充電台のそばで、お待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you wait beside the charging station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。携帯と充電器をつなぎ、自分の鞄もそばに置いて待ちます。表示が変わるか、画面を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人と鞄がそばで待ち充電表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll connect my phone and charger, put my own bag beside me and wait. I'll check the screen to see whether the indicator changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you and your bag will stay nearby while you check the charging indicator. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 充電の表示は出ていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出ました。着いた先で家族に電話できる分を用意したいので、今はここで少し待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着先で家族へ連絡するため充電したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, it is. I want enough charge to call my family when I arrive, so I'll wait here a little now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to charge the phone so you can contact your family at your destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お時間になったら、お持ちの物を全部お取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When it's time, please take all your belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十分たちました。携帯を外し、充電器とコードも鞄へ戻します。台に残っていないことを見てから乗り場へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十分後端末充電器コードを回収し乗場へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ten minutes have passed. I'll disconnect my phone and put the charger and cable back in my bag too. I'll check that nothing is left on the station before going to the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After ten minutes, collect the phone, charger and cable and head to the platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お荷物をおまとめください。目的地でも無事に連絡が取れますように。お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please gather your belongings. I hope you can contact your family safely at your destination too. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域案内のお手伝いについてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about helping with the local guide?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ベトナム語の案内を作る協力者を募集していると聞きました。母語で読んで、分かりにくい見出しなどを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母語ベトナム語で地域案内見出し等の確認協力を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard you're looking for people to help make a Vietnamese guide. I'd like to read it in my native language and check headings and other things that may be hard to understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Offer to check headings and similar details in the local guide in your native Vietnamese. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの部分のお手伝いをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which part would you like to help with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 地図の地名が、日本語の地図と同じ場所を指すか見たいです。見出しの言葉も、読む人に伝わるか確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図地名の位置一致と見出し理解を確認できると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to see whether the place names on the map refer to the same locations as on the Japanese map. I can also check whether readers will understand the wording of the headings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you can check that map place names match locations and headings are understandable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ希望を伝えます。確認用の資料は、メールで受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll pass your wishes on to the person in charge. Can you receive the material to check by email?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受け取れます。日本語の元の案内と、確認するベトナム語の文章を一緒に送ってもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: メールで日本語原案と確認訳の同時受領を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. It would help if you could send the original Japanese guide together with the Vietnamese text I'm to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request to receive the Japanese original and the translation to check together by email. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望の作業と、連絡先をこちらへお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please write the work you'd like to do and your contact details here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 地名と見出しの確認と書きます。連絡先には自分のメールアドレスを入れ、名前も記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 希望作業氏名本人メールを用紙へ書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write 'checking place names and headings.' I'll enter my own email address as the contact detail and write my name too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write your requested work, name and own email address on the form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から、作業の内容と資料の受け取りについてご連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will contact you about the work and receiving the materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。連絡をいただいたら、確認するページと返す方法を聞きます。今日書いた自分の希望もメモに残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡後確認ページ返却方法を聞き希望を自分メモに残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. When they contact me, I'll ask which pages to check and how to return them. I'll also keep a note of the work I offered to do today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after being contacted you will ask about pages and the return method, and keep your own note of your wishes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご希望を担当へお伝えします。ご協力のお申し出ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll pass your wishes on to the person in charge. Thank you for offering to help. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お付き添いの方は、まだこちらにいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the person accompanying you still here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 姉が来ていますが、仕事へ戻るので兄と交代します。診察を受ける私は、ここで待っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受診本人は待合に残り姉から兄へ付き添い交代を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My older sister is here, but she's going back to work, so my older brother will take over. I'm the patient, and I'll wait here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you, the patient, will remain in the waiting area while your older brother replaces your older sister as your companion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お兄様は、いつご到着の予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: When is your older brother expected to arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あと十五分くらいです。姉は兄が着く前に帰るので、間は私一人で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十五分後兄到着まで一人待機を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: In about fifteen minutes. My sister will leave before he gets here, so I'll wait alone in between.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will wait alone until your older brother arrives in fifteen minutes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お荷物は、姉の方がお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Does your sister have your belongings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 姉が私の鞄を持っています。帰る前に私へ渡してもらい、兄には自分の荷物だけ持って来てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 姉から本人鞄を受け取り兄は自荷物のみと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My sister has my bag. I'll have her give it to me before she leaves, and ask my brother to bring only his own belongings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will receive your bag from your older sister and your older brother will bring only his own belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お兄様が来られたら、こちらの受付でお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: When your older brother arrives, please have him speak to us at this reception desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そう伝えます。兄に一緒に聞いてほしいことがあるので、着いたらまずこの待合席へ来てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 兄へ受付声掛け後待合席合流を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell him. There's something I'd like him to hear with me, so I'll ask him to come to this waiting seat first when he arrives.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your older brother to speak to reception and then join you at your waiting seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お待ちの席を、お兄様へ伝えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you tell your older brother where you are sitting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口から二列目の右側です。番号の紙は私が持ち、兄にも番号を見せます。交代することを伝えられて安心しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待合席位置と本人保管の番号紙を兄に示すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: On the right in the second row from the entrance. I'll keep the number slip and show him the number too. I'm relieved I've been able to tell you about the change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe your waiting seat and say you will show your older brother the number slip you are keeping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お兄様がいらしたらお知らせください。それでは、こちらでお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please let us know when your older brother arrives. Please wait here, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 前にご相談になった件の資料でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are these documents about the matter you consulted us on before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。自転車のことで先週相談しました。修理店で見てもらい、見積書ができたので、追加でお渡ししたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先週自転車相談へ修理見積書を追加提出したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I consulted you about my bicycle last week. A repair shop has looked at it and prepared an estimate, so I'd like to submit that as an additional document.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to add a repair estimate to last week's bicycle consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前の相談の控えは、お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have your copy of the previous consultation record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。控えにある日付と名前で、前の件を確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前相談控えの日付氏名で件の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. Could you identify the earlier matter using the date and name on the copy?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the earlier matter to be identified by the date and name on your consultation copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認して担当へつなぎます。見積書は一枚ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check and put you in touch with the person in charge. The estimate is one sheet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一枚です。自分の原本を手元に残したいので、同じ内容のコピーを持って来ました。コピーをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一枚原本保管のため同内容コピーを渡すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, one sheet. I want to keep my original, so I've brought a copy with the same information. I'll give you the copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will hand over an identical one-sheet copy so you can keep the original. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで追加資料としてお預かりします。担当へ伝えたいこともございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll keep this as an additional document. Is there anything else you would like the person in charge to know?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 修理店へ見せた日を伝えたいです。昨日の午後です。自分の予定表にも、その日を書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昨日午後に修理店へ見せた日を追加する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to tell them when I showed it to the repair shop: yesterday afternoon. I've written that date in my own planner too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add that you showed it to the repair shop yesterday afternoon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ、その日付と資料の内容をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the person in charge the date and what the document contains.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。コピーを渡しました。原本と前の控えは鞄へ戻し、担当の方から質問があれば、それを見て答えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: コピー提出原本控え保管後担当質問に答えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I've handed over the copy. I'll put the original and the earlier consultation copy back in my bag, and refer to them if the person in charge has questions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have submitted the copy, will keep the original and consultation copy, and answer the person's questions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料を確かにお預かりしました。それでは、担当へお伝えします。お越しいただきありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received the document. I'll pass it on to the person in charge. Thank you for coming. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのはがきは、今書き終えたところですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you just finished writing that postcard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。宛名のインクがまだ湿っています。ほかの手紙へ重ねずに、少し置ける場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 湿った宛名インクのはがきを重ねず置く場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The address ink is still wet. Is there somewhere I can leave it briefly without putting it on top of the other letters?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where you can leave the postcard with wet address ink without stacking it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 記入台の端をお使いいただけます。文字の面を上にして置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use the edge of the writing counter. Please put it with the writing facing up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこへ一枚だけ置きます。ほかの二通は乾いているので、先にそちらを差し出してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一枚を置き乾いた二通を先差出しできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll put just one there. The other two are dry; may I hand those in first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can leave one to dry and hand in the two dry items first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二通を先にお預かりできます。乾かしている一枚は、お手元の物としてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can take the two first. Please keep responsibility for the one drying while you wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、この二通を先にお渡しします。はがきは台へ置いたまま見える所で待ち、置き忘れないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二通提出後はがきを見える場所で待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll give you these two first. I'll leave the postcard on the counter and wait where I can see it, so I won't forget it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will submit the two items and wait where you can see the postcard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人と待ち合わせています。少し遅れると連絡してあるので、乾いたか確認してから戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人へ遅れを連絡済で乾燥確認後戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm meeting a friend. I've told them I'll be a little late, so I'll go back after checking that it's dry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you've told your friend you'll be late and will return after checking it is dry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はがきを差し出す時は、宛先の文字も見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you hand in the postcard, please check the address lettering again too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 読めるまま乾きました。台から取り、ほかに紙を残していないことも見ました。この一枚を今お渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 可読乾燥と置忘なしを確認して最後一枚を渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's dried and is still legible. I've taken it off the counter and checked I haven't left any other paper. I'll give you this last one now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check that it is dry and legible and nothing has been forgotten, then hand over the last item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、このはがきもお預かりします。ご準備ありがとうございました。ご友人との時間をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll take this postcard too, then. Thank you for getting it ready. Enjoy your time with your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の依頼書について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the bank transfer request form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 請求書の代金を払います。依頼人の名前の前に、お客様番号を付けてほしいと指定されています。どこへ書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 請求代金振込に指定客番号を依頼人名へ付ける欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm paying an invoice. It says to put my customer number before the sender's name. Where should I write that?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which sender-name field to use for the specified customer number when paying the invoice by bank transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの依頼人の欄です。指定の番号と、お名前を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this sender field here. Please tell me the specified number and your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号はＡ２７、名前はグエンです。「Ａ２７ グエン」と、番号を先にして書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 架空番号Ａ２７とグエンの順の表示を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The number is A27 and my name is Nguyen. I'd like to write 'A27 Nguyen,' with the number first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request the fictitious number A27 followed by Nguyen in that order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その並びでご記入ください。請求書の指定も、ここで一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write them in that order. Let's also check the invoice's instructions here together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この行に同じ番号があります。用紙へＡ２７と名前を書きました。受取先の情報は、別にこの請求書を見て写します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 請求書の番号一致と依頼人記入後受取先を別欄へ転記する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: This line has the same number. I've written A27 and my name on the form. I'll separately copy the recipient details from this invoice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that the invoice number matches, and copy the recipient details into their separate fields after completing the sender field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご依頼の金額は、おいくらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: How much would you like to transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二万五千円です。受取先の情報も書けたので、金額の欄には二万五千円と記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二万五千円を金額欄へ記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Twenty-five thousand yen. I've also completed the recipient details, so I'll enter twenty-five thousand yen in the amount field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will enter twenty-five thousand yen in the amount field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご記入の内容と、ご本人の資料を確認します。指定を書いた請求書もお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check what you have written and your personal documents. Please also show me the invoice with the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらです。番号と名前の並び、受取先、二万五千円を請求書と照らして見ていただき、振込の依頼をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人資料請求書を示し指定順受取先金額の照合と振込依頼をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here they are. Please check the number and name order, the recipient and the twenty-five thousand yen against the invoice, and process the transfer request.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show your personal documents and invoice, request a check of the specified order, recipient and amount, and ask for the transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、用紙と資料をお預かりして確認します。ご準備ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll take the form and documents to check them. Thank you for preparing them. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お買い物の後に、お忘れの物はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you forgot after shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: アイスを一つ買いましたが、スプーンを取り忘れました。外で食べたいので、一ついただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入済アイス用の使い切りスプーン一つを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought one ice cream but forgot to take a spoon. I'd like to eat it outside; could I have one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request one disposable spoon for the ice cream you have already bought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お買い上げの商品を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me the item you bought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このカップです。レシートもあります。まだ開けていないので、このままお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封カップとレシートを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's this cup. I have the receipt too. I haven't opened it yet, so I'll show it to you as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the unopened cup and receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの使い切りのスプーンを一つどうぞ。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。紙のナプキンも一枚いただけますか。ふたを外す時に、手元へ敷きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ふた取外し用にナプキン一枚も求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Could I also have one paper napkin? I'd like to lay it beneath my hands when I take the lid off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Also request one napkin to use while removing the lid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの一枚をお使いください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: スプーンとナプキンを受け取りました。カップは袋へ戻し、スプーンも一緒に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二付属物受領と商品袋への収納を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've received the spoon and napkin. I'll put the cup back in the bag and put the spoon in with it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have received both accessories and will put them with the product in the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お待ち合わせの方は、いらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is someone waiting to meet you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人が店の外で待っています。そこで座れる場所へ移ってから開けます。今日は追加の商品を買う用事はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外で友人合流後に開け追加購入なしと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: My friend is waiting outside the shop. I'll move to somewhere we can sit there before opening it. I don't need to buy any additional items today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will join your friend outside, open it afterward, and make no additional purchases. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お受け取りの物もお忘れなく。おいしく召し上がってください。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please don't forget the things you received either. Enjoy your ice cream. Thank you for shopping with us.
